observed_chain: Whole actual Allay595, AllayAi139, JukeboxBlockEntity191, RecordItem114 and JukeboxBlock117 plus seven whole event/container support types were read. Native archive is the actual official-mapped Forge1.20.1 source artifact, not an invented upstream mod Git revision or runtime installation. Primary state policy, placement hints, read/write, sound/heart helpers and collector sidebranches count as at most one pending whole ecology mechanism.

RecordItem.useOn on empty HAS_RECORD jukebox performs server-side setFirstItem(stack.copy()) via ContainerSingleItem to setItem. setItem requires MUSIC_DISCS tag and nonnull level, stores stack, sets HAS_RECORD and startPlaying. startPlaying sets recordStartedTick=tickCount and isPlaying; it does not itself post JUKEBOX_PLAY. Caller shrinks1 and requests PLAY_RECORD stat on normal server return even if no suitable BE was obtained. This context is not a successful record-insertion receipt or an extra ecology case.

JukeboxBlock.getTicker exists only with HAS_RECORD and matching helper type. Each actual BE tick increments ticksSinceLastEvent, requires nonempty current stack plus isPlaying plus RecordItem class, stops when tickCount>=recordStartedTick+record.lengthInTicks+20; otherwise when ticksSinceLastEvent>=20 resets event counter and posts JUKEBOX_PLAY, then cosmetic particles. tickCount increments after branch. Event counter also accrues while not playing if ticked; no fixed initial20-tick delay or wall-clock/minute guarantee. Native constructor seconds-to-ticks and Forge supplier constructor already-in-ticks differ; no specific loaded disc duration asserted.

stopPlaying sets isPlaying=false before JUKEBOX_STOP_PLAY, neighbor/cosmetic events and setChanged. removeItem clears slot then stops only for nonempty former stack. popOutRecord server path removes first, makes a copied item entity and ignores add result; JukeboxBlock.use/removal call it. Record extraction/particle output are supporting context, not paid offspring or actual player acquisition.

LevelAccessor maps block position to center. ServerLevel gameEvent is cancellable by Forge onVanillaGameEvent before dispatcher. Dispatcher visits only currently available chunk registries in event radius; native JUKEBOX_PLAY and STOP both radius10. Euclidean registry resolves listener position and uses distance squared<=listenerRadius squared; no LOS predicate appears on this path. Actual tracking callbacks add/move/remove Allay dynamic listeners; DynamicGameEventListener uses FULL chunks with create=false, so registration and delivery are conditional, not force-load or actual-play proof.

Allay constructor gives JukeboxListener the VibrationUser EntityPositionSource at eye offset and radius10. It directly handles only JUKEBOX_PLAY and STOP; this is separate from the vibration/noteblock delivery-memory route. PLAY takes the block position only when not already dancing, so a later play source does not immediately replace an active source. STOP clears only for matching remembered block or null remembered source. JukeboxListener handling returns true after the setter call, not proof setter accepted the transition.

setDancing changes DATA_DANCING only on server with effective AI, and true is refused while IS_PANICKING memory present. Mob/Entity effective-AI methods require server and !NoAi. The same effective-AI condition applies to false; do not claim universal panic/NoAi stop. Allay tick requests stop when panicking. Dancing aiStep rechecks on tickCount%20==0 that remembered block exists, base entity position is strictly within center-radius10 and block is JUKEBOX; it does not poll BE isRecordPlaying. This recheck differs from the listener eye-position inclusive-distance boundary. Dropped/cancelled stop events need not immediately clear dancing; no runtime stuck-dance claim.

DUPLICATION_ITEM is explicit Ingredient.of(Items.AMETHYST_SHARD), not an unread duplication tag. Ingredient.of(ItemLike...) constructs stacks and test compares item identity. mobInteract gates isDancing, that ingredient and canDuplicate boolean; it has no liked-player ownership test, mate/baby requirement or direct long-cooldown comparison. Collector hand-in/return and liked-player/noteblock behaviors were read but have zero separate credit. No dependency on live sound amplitude/OS audio is present in this source path; no sound was played.

The admitted mobInteract branch invokes duplicateAllay FIRST, then heart entity event18 and AMETHYST_BLOCK_CHIME request, then removeInteractionItem (shrink1 unless instabuild), and returns SUCCESS, without helper success value or its own client guard. Helper creates nullable EntityType.ALLAY actor, positions it at parent position, sets persistenceRequired, resets CHILD cooldown then PARENT cooldown to6000 and false, and only then calls addFreshEntity ignoring boolean. Constructor registration and create feature gate were read. If create returns null on normal return, no cooldown is reset but outer effect/payment/SUCCESS still execute; if admission fails after nonnull create, both gates were already armed. All inferences assume preceding calls return, not transactional/exception/rollback guarantees.

Native packet interaction uses server target/world-border/reach/enabled-item gates, Player.interactOn spectator/Forge cancellation then Mob.interact alive/leash/important-interaction gates before mobInteract. A successful InteractionResult can trigger generic PLAYER_INTERACTED_WITH_ENTITY after branch; that is not proof child admission or native birth. No client-prediction reconciliation, packet replay or duplicate exploit was executed or certified.

ServerLevel.addFreshEntity delegates addEntity which rejects removed actors and requires entityManager add success. PersistentEntitySectionManager posts cancellable EntityJoinLevelEvent before UUID admission and tracking; duplicate UUID also rejects. Therefore ignored add is not harmless or guaranteed population gain. No explicit mating/finalizeSpawn/placement/obstruction/NaturalSpawner cap call appears in this direct source path; no universal cross-mod cap or event bypass is claimed. Parent is not discarded; child setPersistenceRequired only sets a flag, not universal survival.

Fresh Allay defines CanDuplicate=true with long timer initially0. updateDuplicationCooldown decrements only positive value, then on server at exactly0 restores false gate to true; decrement call lies outside own aiStep server guard.6000 is counter updates, not verified elapsed game minutes. Stored boolean and timer are separate: reading does not normalize an inconsistent positive-timer/true-flag combination, negative timers are not decremented by shown loop. No runtime corrupt-save exploit or automatic recovery claim.

Own writer records inventory, optional encoded vibration listener, DuplicationCooldown with putLong and CanDuplicate boolean; reader optionally parses listener with resultOrPartial and reads cooldown via getInt cast long. Normal6000 fits, arbitrary longs are not guaranteed preserved. DATA_DANCING, jukeboxPos and music visual phase are not written/read in these own methods; fresh reconstruction differs from applying reader to existing object, whose unmentioned fields are not cleared. Child creation does not explicitly copy parent hand/inventory/liked-player/listener/source or saved cooldown. No full inherited NBT/reload, ownership transfer or exactly-once reconstruction proof.

Full original semantic decisions for nearest EA17/18/19 are reused with actual current decision fields stated; EA10/13 fields were read, and own EA22/29 judgments reused. Existing migration owners already cover Allay cooldown/inventory read and jukebox record/paired-clock read; their complete canonical rows are bound and contribute zero global/migration novelty. Keyword screening of ecology batch files found no allay/jukebox/asexual/music-gated text; that screen alone is not semantic independence.
